info.name: My Dream Board API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the **My Dream Board** mobile app and admin dashboard.

## Structure

The app is built around one hierarchy:

**Dream Board → Dream → Goal → Milestone**

- A **Dream Board** is a themed wall ("Dream Life 2026")
- A **Dream** is one framed picture on it — image + title + Dream Story ("Become a professional speaker")
- A **Goal** is the project that makes that Dream real ("Book 5 speaking gigs")
- A **Milestone** is a tick-box step inside the Goal

Progress flows upward automatically: ticking a Milestone updates its Goal %, which updates the Dream %, which updates the Board %. You never calculate or send a percentage — read it.

Attaching a Goal to a Dream is **optional**. `goal.dream` may be `null`.

## Getting started

1. Import `My-Dream-Board.postman_environment.json` and select it.
2. Run **Auth → Login**. The access and refresh tokens save to the environment automatically.
3. Run **Admin → Login as Admin** to fill `{{adminToken}}`.
4. Run any list endpoint (Goals, Dream Boards…) — resource ids like `{{goalId}}` and `{{dreamId}}` are captured automatically, so detail endpoints work with no copy-pasting.

Most GET requests ship with a **saved example response** — open the request and click "Example response" to see the exact JSON shape without sending anything.

## Screen → endpoint map

| Screen | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Sign Up / Verify OTP | `POST /auth/register` → `POST /auth/verify-email` |
| Sign In | `POST /auth/login` |
| Forgot → OTP → Reset | `/auth/forgot-password` → `/auth/verify-otp` → `/auth/reset-password` |
| Home | `GET /home` (one call for the whole screen) |
| Goals list + filter chips | `GET /goals` + `GET /content/areas` |
| New goal | `POST /goals` |
| "Part of which dream?" picker | `GET /dreams` |
| Goal detail | `GET /goals/:id` |
| New milestone | `POST /goals/:id/milestones` |
| Milestone checkbox | `PATCH /milestones/:id/toggle` |
| Vision tab (board list) | `GET /boards` |
| Create Dream Board | `POST /boards` |
| Dream Board detail | `GET /boards/:id` |
| New / Edit Dream | `POST` / `PATCH /boards/:id/dreams/:dreamId` |
| Dream detail | `GET /boards/:id/dreams/:dreamId` |
| Collage | `PATCH /boards/:id/collage` + `GET /content/collage-layouts` |
| Progress tab | `GET /progress` |
| Achievements | `GET /achievements` |
| Profile | `GET /users/me` + `GET /users/me/stats` |
| Settings | `GET /settings` + `PATCH /settings/notifications` |
| "+ Add your own" area | `POST /content/areas` |
| Admin dashboard | `GET /admin/dashboard/overview` |
| Admin All Users | `GET /admin/users` |
| Admin Add Content | `/admin/content/*` |

## Response shape

Success:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 10, "total": 42, "totalPage": 5 }, "data": {} }
```
`meta` only appears on paginated lists.

Error:
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Validation failed", "errorSources": [{ "path": "body.email", "message": "Must be a valid email address" }] }
```

## Two things that save you time

**Dates come pre-formatted.** Every date field is returned as raw ISO **and** as a ready-to-render label — `dueLabel: "In 3 days"`, `updatedLabel: "Just now"`, `joiningDate: "Jul 27, 2026"`, `milestoneProgressLabel: "2 of 4 milestones complete"`. All computed in the user's timezone. Use whichever suits.

**Auth.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Access tokens last 15 minutes — on a 401, call `POST /auth/refresh-token` and retry. Changing or resetting a password invalidates every session.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sign Up, Sign In, Forgot Password, Enter OTP and Reset Password screens.

OTP policy: 6 digits, 5 minute expiry, 45 second resend cooldown, 5 verify attempts. Every OTP response returns `resendAfter` so the client countdown is server-authoritative.

request.description:
Sign Up screen. Creates an unverified account and emails a 6 digit OTP. Returns `{ email, expiresIn, resendAfter }` and NO tokens - the client should route to the Enter OTP screen.

Accepts either `userName` or `firstName`/`lastName`; the other form is derived automatically.
Enter OTP screen (signup flow). On success returns the user plus access and refresh tokens, which are saved to the environment.

Sign In screen. Saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` to the environment.

If the account is unverified the API responds 403 with `data.needsVerification = true` and re-sends the OTP, so the client can route to the Enter OTP screen.

Optionally pass `deviceToken` and `platform` to register for push in the same call.
Silent refresh with rotation - the old refresh token is revoked.
Forgot Password screen. Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists (anti account-enumeration).

RESEND OTP button. Returns 429 with the remaining seconds if called inside the 45 second cooldown.

`type` is `email_verification` or `password_reset`.

Enter OTP screen (reset flow). Returns a single-use, short-lived `resetToken` saved to the environment.

If `type` is `email_verification` this behaves like Verify Email and returns tokens instead.

request.description: Single milestone with its parent goal.
Edit the title or due date.

The circular checkbox on the Goal detail screen, and the single most important endpoint in the app.

One call: flips the completion state, recalculates the goal progress and status, writes an activity log, updates the day streak and evaluates achievements.

Returns `{ milestone, goal, streak }` so the whole screen updates in one round-trip.

Completing every milestone flips the goal to `completed`. Un-checking one reverts it to `active` and nulls `completedAt`.
Drag-to-reorder milestones inside a goal. Send every affected milestone with its new order index.
Soft-deletes and recalculates the parent goal.

item.name: Dream Boards

Vision tab: board list, Create Dream Board, board detail, collage and the full-screen viewer.
